strings.zh: 我在这里为捣毁地鼠洞穴做准备工作,{NEWLINE}虽然很不想破坏它们的栖息地,{CLEAR}但是在金婆婆旗下的建筑公司打工,{CLEAR}不听她的就得失业了啊……{SCROLL}希望马志士馆主{NEWLINE}能及时跟精灵联盟取得联系,{CLEAR}赶紧制止这场生态灾难吧。
strings.en: I’m getting things ready to destroy{NEWLINE}Diglett’s Cave. I really don’t want to{CLEAR}wreck their habitat...{SCROLL}But I work for Granny Kin’s{NEWLINE}construction company. If I don’t do as{CLEAR}she says, I’m out of a job...{SCROLL}I hope Lt. Surge gets through to the{NEWLINE}Pokémon League in time...{SCROLL}...and stops this ecological disaster.
strings.notes: | RV008: softened: 捣毁 = destroy, not dig up (D-1685)

strings.zh: 胡说盆栽真的是{NEWLINE}非常小巧可爱啊！{SCROLL}太谢谢你愿意跟我交换了！
strings.en: This Bonsly really is so tiny and cute!{SCROLL}Thank you so much for trading with me!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}把小刚登录到了手机上！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} registered Brock{NEWLINE}in the Pokégear!

strings.zh: 有些破损的古代精灵雕像。
strings.en: A partly broken ancient Pokémon{NEWLINE}statue.

strings.zh: 这个洞穴的温度好高啊,{NEWLINE}我怀疑是有什么东西{CLEAR}在不停地散发热量。
strings.en: It’s so hot in this cave.{NEWLINE}I suspect something in here{CLEAR}is giving off heat nonstop.

strings.zh: 原来我探测到的庞大能量{NEWLINE}是这块石头发出来的,{CLEAR}我调查了一下发现{CLEAR}这好像不是地球的物质。{SCROLL}太神奇了,这到底是什么呢？
strings.en: So the huge energy I detected{NEWLINE}was coming from this stone!{CLEAR}I looked into it...{SCROLL}...and it doesn’t seem to be made of{NEWLINE}anything from this planet.{SCROLL}Amazing... What on earth is it?

strings.zh: 看到那边的精灵球了吗？{NEWLINE}好想去拿但是拿不到啊！{CLEAR}如果让精灵学会攀岩技能机的话,{CLEAR}就能爬上那样的地方了。
strings.en: See that Poké Ball over there? I really{NEWLINE}want it, but I can’t reach it!{SCROLL}If your Pokémon learned Rock Climb, you{NEWLINE}could climb up places like that.
strings.notes: zh says 攀岩技能机 (a Rock Climb TM/HM disc); English just says Rock Climb.

strings.zh: 哇！你攀上了那边的岩石！{NEWLINE}看来你已经拿到攀岩技能机了啊。
strings.en: Wow! You climbed up those rocks! Looks{NEWLINE}like you’ve already got Rock Climb.

strings.zh: 洞穴的温度似乎降下来了,{NEWLINE}是发热源消失了吗？
strings.en: The cave seems to have cooled down. Did{NEWLINE}the heat source disappear?

strings.zh: 小刚『是吗……{NEWLINE}太遗憾了,不过也没办法。
strings.en: Brock: I see... That’s too bad, but it{NEWLINE}can’t be helped.
strings.notes: US 0047/9 | RV008: omission: 是吗/太遗憾了/也没办法 were reduced to 'That’s OK' (D-1686)

strings.zh: 相册似乎是满了,{SCROLL}请在电脑中整理下照片吧。
strings.en: Your album seems to be full.{SCROLL}Please use a PC to sort out the photos{NEWLINE}in your album.

strings.zh: 你见过名叫胡说盆栽的精灵吗？{SCROLL}好像必须从蛋开始抚养才行……{NEWLINE}非常难见到。{SCROLL}如果你有胡说盆栽的话{NEWLINE}能和我的铁甲犀牛{CLEAR}交换吗？
strings.en: Have you ever seen a Pokémon called{NEWLINE}Bonsly?{SCROLL}I hear you have to raise it from an{NEWLINE}Egg... They’re really hard to find.{SCROLL}If you have a Bonsly, would you trade it{NEWLINE}for my Rhyhorn?
strings.notes: The hack dropped the vanilla Brock label from this trade (#11–18): generic NPC, no speaker label.

strings.zh: 太好了！{NEWLINE}好,我们交换吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Great! Okay, let’s trade!{SCROLL}

strings.en: So you don’t have a Bonsly either! If{NEWLINE}you find one, please trade with me!

strings.zh: 我正在寻找胡说盆栽……{NEWLINE}能用我的铁甲犀牛{CLEAR}和你交换吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: I’m looking for a Bonsly... Will you{NEWLINE}trade it for my Rhyhorn?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 谢谢！{NEWLINE}我一直想要胡说盆栽！{SCROLL}我给你的铁甲犀牛{NEWLINE}是我从蛋状态开始养育的,{SCROLL}它还会雷之牙,{NEWLINE}是我引以为傲的一只铁甲犀牛。{SCROLL}克制它的水系精灵{NEWLINE}反而会被它克制,{CLEAR}请好好地培育它吧！
strings.en: Thank you! I’ve always wanted a{NEWLINE}Bonsly!{SCROLL}I raised that Rhyhorn from an Egg...{SCROLL}It even knows Thunder Fang. It’s my{NEWLINE}pride and joy.{SCROLL}Water types that usually have the edge{NEWLINE}on it get zapped instead. Please raise{CLEAR}it well!

strings.zh: 那只铁甲犀牛{NEWLINE}是我从蛋状态开始养育的,{SCROLL}甚至还会雷之牙,{NEWLINE}是我引以为傲的一只铁甲犀牛。{SCROLL}克制它的水系精灵{NEWLINE}反而会被它克制,{CLEAR}请好好地培育它吧！

strings.zh: 喂,喂,~{NEWLINE}那可不是胡说盆栽啊！
strings.en: Hey, hey... That’s not a Bonsly!

strings.zh: 小刚『{VAR:0103:0}？{NEWLINE}这么巧你也来地鼠洞穴了啊。{CLEAR}要不要跟我拍张纪念照片呢？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Brock: {VAR:0103:0}? Fancy running into you{NEWLINE}in Diglett’s Cave too.{SCROLL}Want to take a souvenir photo with me?{SCROLL}

strings.en: Brock: All righty!{NEWLINE}Stand next to me and relax!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 小刚『好了！{NEWLINE}留下了美好的记忆吧！
strings.en: Brock: Yes!{NEWLINE}Another great memory!
